title: Hash table
subtitle: Trace hash functions, collision resolution, probe arcs, tombstones, and rehashing.

hint.chaining: Each bucket holds a linked chain for colliding keys.
hint.linear: Checks consecutive slots: (h(k) + i) mod m.
hint.double: Steps by a second hash: (h₁(k) + i · h₂(k)) mod m.

operations.label: Integer key
operations.rehashTitle: Expand to next prime ≥ 2m and purge tombstones

playback.label: Playback
playback.idleMessage: Insert, search, or delete an integer key—or load a sample—to step through hashing.

errors.integerOnly: Only whole integers (including 0 and negatives) are allowed.
errors.tableFull: Table is full. Rehash to expand capacity.
errors.probeCycle: Probe sequence cycled without finding an open slot. Rehash to expand.

steps.computeHash: Compute {{formula}} for key {{key}} — starting at bucket {{index}}.
steps.duplicateFound: Key {{key}} is already present at index {{index}}; duplicate insert skipped.
steps.chainCheckNode: Bucket {{index}} node {{pos}} holds {{existing}} ≠ {{key}}; continue walking the chain.
steps.insertChainEmpty: Bucket {{index}} was empty; inserted key {{key}} as the head node.
steps.insertChainAppend: Collision at bucket {{index}}: appended key {{key}} to the chain (length {{length}}).
steps.probeCollision: Probe #{{step}}: slot {{index}} is occupied by {{existing}} — collision, probing next slot.
steps.tombstoneRemember: Slot {{index}} is a tombstone (DEL) — remembered as first reusable slot while scanning for duplicates.
steps.tombstoneSkip: Slot {{index}} is a tombstone (DEL) — keeping slot {{firstIndex}} as target and continuing duplicate check.
steps.insertReuseTombstone: Reached empty slot {{emptyIndex}} with no duplicate; inserted key {{key}} into remembered tombstone slot {{index}}.
steps.insertReuseAfterScan: Finished checking all reachable slots with no duplicate; inserted key {{key}} into tombstone slot {{index}}.
steps.probeCycle: Probe sequence repeated slot {{index}} after {{probes}} probes while inserting {{key}} — rehash to expand.
steps.tableFull: All {{capacity}} slots are occupied; cannot insert key {{key}}. Rehash to expand.
steps.searchFoundChain: Found key {{key}} in bucket {{index}} at chain position {{pos}}.
steps.searchNotFoundChain: Reached end of bucket {{index}}; key {{key}} is not in the table.
steps.searchCycleStop: Probe sequence repeated slot {{index}}; key {{key}} is not in the table.
steps.searchEmptyStop: Slot {{index}} is empty — stop search; key {{key}} is not in the table.
steps.searchSkipTombstone: Slot {{index}} is a tombstone (DEL) — skip past it while searching for {{key}}.
steps.searchFound: Found key {{key}} at slot {{index}} after {{probes}} probes.
steps.searchExhausted: Probed all {{capacity}} slots; key {{key}} is not in the table.
steps.deleteTombstone: Deleted key {{key}} at slot {{index}} by marking it DELETED (tombstone) to preserve probe chains.
steps.deleteNotFound: Key {{key}} was not found; nothing deleted.
steps.rehashStart: Rehashing from m = {{oldM}} to prime m = {{newM}}: moving {{count}} active keys and purging {{purged}} tombstones.
steps.rehashDone: Rehash complete: {{count}} keys stored in m = {{newM}} slots with 0 tombstones.
steps.sampleLoaded: Loaded sample keys [{{keys}}] into table of size m = {{capacity}}.
